studies.label: Coupled cell: an ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS fate network form a metabolism↔fate oscillator
Coupled cell: a Smoldyn particle population catalyses an ODE (particle count sets the ODE rate)
Coupled cell: all three sub-cellular formalisms and all three coupling modes in one cell
Fateful tissue: a dividing tyssue whose divisions are decided by each cell's own metabolism→fate chain
Smoldyn particles bounded by Cellular Potts (CPM) voxel cells: confinement, conservation across division, reaction equilibrium
Smoldyn particles bounded by tyssue (vertex) polygons: confinement, conservation across division, reaction equilibrium
Smoldyn particles bounded by center-based (viva-munk) discs: confinement, conservation across division, reaction equilibrium
Model-definition format: one scene, three cell types, three formalisms (ODE, Smoldyn particles, MaBoSS) sharing an extracellular field
